"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/convert-date-to-binary/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

3280. Convert Date to Binary

You are given a string date representing a Gregorian calendar date in the yyyy-mm-dd format.

date can be written in its binary representation obtained by converting year, month, and day to their binary representations without any leading zeroes and writing them down in year-month-day format.

Return the binary representation of date.

Example 1:

Input: date = "2080-02-29"
Output: "100000100000-10-11101"
Explanation:
100000100000, 10, and 11101 are the binary representations of 2080, 02, and 29 respectively.

Example 2:

Input: date = "1900-01-01"
Output: "11101101100-1-1"
Explanation:
11101101100, 1, and 1 are the binary representations of 1900, 1, and 1 respectively.

Constraints:

    date.length == 10
    date[4] == date[7] == '-' , and all other date[i]'s are digits.
    The input is generated such that date represents a valid Gregorian calendar date between Jan 1st, 1900 and Dec 31st, 2100 (both inclusive).
"""


class Solution:
    def convertDateToBinary(self, date: str) -> str:
        year_str, month_str, day_str = date.split("-")
        year_bin = bin(int(year_str))[2:]
        month_bin = bin(int(month_str))[2:]
        day_bin = bin(int(day_str))[2:]
        return f"{year_bin}-{month_bin}-{day_bin}"


sol = Solution()

print(sol.convertDateToBinary("2080-02-29"))  # "100000100000-10-11101"

assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2080-02-29") == "100000100000-10-11101"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("1900-01-01") == "11101101100-1-1"

assert sol.convertDateToBinary("1900-12-31") == "11101101100-1100-11111"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2100-01-01") == "100000110100-1-1"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2100-12-31") == "100000110100-1100-11111"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2000-02-29") == "11111010000-10-11101"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("1999-11-11") == "11111001111-1011-1011"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("1900-02-28") == "11101101100-10-11100"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2001-03-01") == "11111010001-11-1"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2016-02-29") == "11111100000-10-11101"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2020-10-10") == "11111100100-1010-1010"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("1900-06-15") == "11101101100-110-1111"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2100-07-04") == "100000110100-111-100"
assert sol.convertDateToBinary("2004-02-29") == "11111010100-10-11101"
